summary: A glass app bar with a title on the left and search, notifications and avatar on the right, inside a flush glass card.
use: Top bar of a page or panel with a product title and a few global quick actions.
spec: `<Card material="glass" full flush>` wraps the bar
`{#snippet trailing()}` holds two `IconButton` items with `aria-label="Search"` and `aria-label="Notifications"`
Trailing also has `<Avatar alt="Ada L" size="sm" />`
Icons are `<Search size={18} />` and `<Bell size={18} />` from `@lucide/svelte`
